title: RSSB Lab Assistant Answer Key 2026 – Out
intro: Short Information : Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has released the Answer Key for the recruitment of Lab Assistant Posts on the official website. This recruitment was released for 804 posts. Applications for the RSSB Lab Assistant Recruitment 2026 were accepted from January 27, 2026, to February 25, 2026. The online examination was conducted on 09, 10 May 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this Examination can download their RSSB Lab Assistant Answer Key 2026 from the link given below.
applicationFee: Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
